profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in node, AWS, Expo, react, PHP, mobile app dev, ci/cd, scrum, and linux.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Creative Group designs global programs and experiences that reward excellence and inspire people to reach their full potential – we call it Thrivability. We have been motivating people since 1970. As a performance improvement company, we specialize in engagement, incentive and recognition solutions, and end-to-end meeting and event management. Creative Group has been honored with the CMI 25 Award, recognizing the top 25 most influential meetings and incentive management companies in the U.S., since the award’s inception in 2007.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and supported several custom built applications using: Laravel 4.x, symfony components, slim w/twig, bootstrap 2/3, backbone.js, marionette, mysql/mariadb. Tested with codeception and phpunit. Dependencies managed with composer and bower. gulp & grunt task runners. Experience with many 3rd party integrations, including payment gateways/vaults, travel services, email, mobile, ERPs, quoting/ordering, asset management, etc. Developed HIPAA, PCI, SOC3 compliant systems. Created custom reporting tools and optimized queries for large/complex data sets. Some shell scripting and system administration work. Troubleshooting for various system and load issues. Some ETL experience, mostly with SugarCRM as the target.

Installed, customized, developed, and maintained dozens of SugarCRM installations (self hosted, client hosted and SOD hosted). Performed upgrades, client trainings, and in-house trainings. Established best practices and SOPs for Sugar installations, development, and maintenance. Discovered, reported, and resolved several SugarCRM bugs.

Migrated systems to AWS. Familiar with EC2, ELBs, S3, RDS/Aurora, AMIs (creation and usage), EBS, Lambda, Dynamo. Learning the dev toolchain (code commit, deploy, pipeline) and becoming familiar with VPC.

Project management duties included being the single point of contact for several of our clients. Managing project deadlines and scope. Sales engineer duties as needed.

Communicate extremely well one-on-one and with clients.

Worked in an agile/scrum environment. Occasionally acted as scrum master and also as product owner for smaller clients.

Familiar with Rally/CA Agile Central, ActiveCollab, and JIRA. Developed customizations for ActiveCollab to better suit agile/scrum processes, billing, and client use cases. Google suite use for IM/chat, conferencing, email, calendaring.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using PHP, maintained a company critical 2 year old mobile marketing template and API plugin system that served 100K+ impressions an hour. Tied in several technologies (memcached, redis) to system for performance optimization.  Performed maintenance and performance tweaks on Apache, MySQL Cluster and Zeus load balancing solutions.  Researched existent and emerging technologies (NoSQL, cloud solutions, load balancing, monitoring, data replication) for additional performance and redundancy gains.  Performed efficiency optimizations to minimize template sprawl and growth while maintaining flexibility and granularity.  Designed queries to pull specific data points and correlations vital to business growth and strategy.  Created reporting system to display real time statistics and aggregate data between our live and warehoused data.

Took over development of the year old internationalization version of the above system.  Extensive template abstraction.  Developed and maintained business and technology contacts worldwide; etc).  Abstracted out the front-end facing components of the system and developed an independent, internationalized version that served both our domestic and international backends.  Merged and abstracted existing code from our international backend into our domestic backend to consolidate codebase.  Designed and transformed existing data to fit new data structures.  Championed svn usage to move development backups from local storage to common, remote svn solution.

Designed and developed an image manipulation project, leveraging existing PHP image manipulation libraries as well as several 3rd party services.  Extensive use of cloud based solutions, primarily Amazon's EC2 and EBS.  Front end load balanced across 3+ EC2 instances, with a single image store on EBS and backended by 3+ EC2 instances which archived to our local warehouse servers to maintain data integrity.

Developed license-free using Notepad++, vim, WinSCP and putty.

company.name: Viveli, Inc. / Social Hour / Game Theory

positions.title: Various
positions.description:
I was in various sales roles for my early Best Buy career. I was responsible for 10-20 people during any given period. Departments made anywhere from $5K-$50K a day. I developed business plans and that would later become standard throughout our district. Other responsibilities: scheduling within labor constraints, meeting and exceeding budgets and goals, merchandising standards and development, selling techniques, motivating and developing my staff, convergence sales, technical training, computer repair and troubleshooting, customer consultations and solution development. I also had to deal with an initially hostile work staff and turn them into a world class sales team.  I won multiple contests at the company, regional and district levels. These positions exemplify how quickly and effectively I can adapt and change to a challenging situation.  Put in a position with little training and a staff that was not friendly, I was able to learn the role myself, improve relationships with my staff and did both while being in the top 5-10% of the company in power rank.

I later worked in various non-sales roles with the company. Responsibilities included: training and motivating a staff of 8-12 employees, shipping/receiving, restocking, asset protection, observation of suspicious activity, securing product, maintaining safe work conditions, pleasant customer service, warehouse appearance, knowledge of mainframe (IBM 3270) and PC based inventory systems, Retek store systems, handheld scanner (Telxon and Symbol) experience, pricing audits, planogram auditing and developing, overstock allocation, product ordering, general product functionality knowledge, employee inspections, employee security, security and safety audits, maintenance of various equipment. These positions required great communications skills, a keen eye for detail, high level of perception and awareness and self motivation. A process orientation and great people development skills helped me succeed.
